summary: Ameren Illinois, a subsidiary of Ameren Corporation, filed an 8-K to report the sale of $400 million principal amount of 5.50% First Mortgage Bonds due 2036. The offering was made under an effective Form S-3 registration statement and a prospectus supplement dated August 17, 2026. Net proceeds were approximately $397.4 million before expenses. The filing includes underwriting agreement and legal opinions. This is a routine debt offering, not a special situation.
